releaseNotes: Text block width and height are now persisted before every tool switch and restored exactly after the Notes view is rebuilt
Pen, Marker and Eraser modes keep the same saved text block geometry instead of reverting to the default block size
Text options are now integrated into the same contextual options area used by Pen and Marker
The floating Aa Textoptionen button and floating panel are retired from the active UI
Text mode shows font, size, bold, italic, underline and delete controls directly below the tool selector
Automatic cleanup of empty text blocks remains enabled
No new APK is required; Shell 1.1.0 remains sufficient
